lines.en: : Okay, everyone! Due to a sudden shortage in paper, we’ll be playing tonight’s game of bar trivia the old-fashioned way! By yelling out the answers for points!
: The game will begin in five minutes, so finalize your strategies now! And remember- teams of two only!
: How did things come to this?
: Seeing as your fake-amnesia is acting up again, I will now recap the last hour of your life. Buckle up, Arakawa. This is going to be good.
: I have a very strong feeling it won’t be.
: The day started normally- when you woke up and decided to go at least another twenty-four hours as the unlovable degenerate you are.
: Things proceeded as normal until Imani, also a degenerate, decided tonight would be a good night for the four of us girls to hang out here for a game of bar trivia.
: You, someone who was not invited, showed up shortly after. And while this would be a tragedy under most circumstances, it wound up working out due to her sudden bout of food poisoning.
: Now, we are enemies and my lover and I will defeat you. Only to subsequently force some form of punishment on the two of you that you will rue for the rest of your lives.
: I hope you are ready to be completely and utterly decimated.
: Thanks, Wakana. You should just handle all of my inner monologues from now on. That was more fun than any recap I could have given.
: It is painful enough being stuck in my own mind. The last thing I want is to be stuck inside of yours as well.
: Are you sure you’re up for this, Rika?
: Up for it? I was born for this.
: I might not seem like it, but I’m a god damn expert at useless trivia. Those dykes next to us don’t stand a chance.
: Woah. I’m all about the competitive spirit and shit, but isn’t it kind of messed up to throw slurs at your own people?
: Love no one. Everyone is your enemy, dick or no dick. Hail Satan.
: Arakawa, tame your partner before my beloved kicks her head off.
: Rika, calm down.
: Fuck you, goober. Do you have any idea what I had to do the last time I lost a punishment game?
: No, but I feel like I’m obligated to ask now.
: Let’s just say it involves a remote-controlled device and me being hunched over an apple display at the grocery store, trying to keep my mouth closed.
: Or maybe it was potatoes. I don’t remember. I was too busy regretting everything I’d ever done.
: That just sounds like a Wednesday for Osako.
: Shh!
: Zap.
: Mm! Ahem...ahem...
: Shh. Did anyone else just hear that?
: Ignore the exhibitionists for a moment. We need to listen to the announcer and figure out our strategy for the game.
: Okay! It’s time to start!
: Nevermind. Just try not to get anything wrong.
: Same goes for you. Don’t hold me back, Sensei. Me and Imani are undefeated so far.
: Granted, we’ve only played one game, but still! I’m not going to lose to a loving, affectionate, and hypersexual couple while being fresh off a long-term relationship! It would be too painful!
: Question one...
: In “Game of Thrones,” what is the translation of the High Valyrian term “valar dohaeris?”
: Do you know this? You read those books, right?
: No. But we did keep the television series on while we were having sex several Sundays out of every year. You just likely don’t remember it since you were always tied up and robbed of your senses.
: All men must serve!
: I have also had sex with that show on in the background!
: That...information was not necessary. But you are correct!
: LET’S FUCKING GOOOOOOO!
: Oh, calm down. You got one question right.
: You know, this is a side of you I don’t particularly dislike. Especially since it means we’ll be able to punish our lesbian friends.
: Oh, yeah! I got so caught up in how great at trivia I am that I completely forgot we can mess with them. Is there anything we-
: Question two!
: Fuck it! We’ll figure that out later! Just shut up and let me think!
: I haven’t even said anything. Also, please don’t attack me unless our clothes are off. Thank you.
: Jesus. Rika’s even more aggressive today than she was last time.
: Shut it, carpet muncher!
: Wasn’t it just the other day you were commenting on how good you are at-
: Shh! Question two!
: “Spiker” and “Sponge” are the antagonists of which Roald Dahl children’s book?
: Oh, I actually know this one.
: What? Then say it. We’re supposed to yell stuff out. Don’t just let Rika and Sensei win.
: Why not?
: Uhh...because you said you were going to decimate him? And because winning is awesome?
: That is true. But with each passing question, I’m becoming more aware that our punishment will likely be sexual in nature and now I’m just curious about what they’d have us do.
: There have...been two questions.
: I’m afraid I don’t see your point, my love.
: Wakana, we can have sex literally any time we want.
: Yes, but how many opportunities do we have to be punished by other people?
: I volunteer to do that exact thing literally any time you want.
: Shut it!
: The two of us are going to beat you guys fair and square and you’ll both regret ever making us-
: Zap.
: Eep!
: Zap.
: Zap.
: Zap.
: Mm...mm!
: It’s never too late to concede, my dear. There will be other trivia games.
: Wakana! We’re with our friends! Stop!
: Question three: How many times can I make you cum before you swallow your pride and follow me into the bathroom?
: Hey! No quitting! Just cross your legs really tightly and tough it out like a real woman!
: Wakana!
: Oh my fucking God! Fine!
: One punishment please, opposing team.
: Fine. Help me paint a wardrobe I found on the side of the road. Rin won’t let me use hers anymore.
: Arakawa, I can’t believe I am saying this, but please think up a punishment for my lover and me.
: Paint Rika’s wardrobe, but do it naked.
: Ooooh, good one.
: You two are worthless.
: Come now, Osako. I’ll think up my own way to punish you.
: Wakanaaaa! Turn the...thing off!
: Does...this mean we win?
: I’d...at least like someone to answer the second question so I don’t have to just stand around anymore.
: Oh, sorry. James and the Giant Peach.
: That is correct!
: But...seeing as you two are now the only team left, I suppose we’ll take a quick intermission and wait for your friends to return from...yeah.

: You can keep asking trivia questions if you want. This is a hidden power of mine and I feel like I’ve barely even gotten to show it off on account of us only making it two rounds in before sex happened.
: No...I think I need a smoke break. But you two have fun for now.
: Oh man...I was looking forward to this.
: If it’s any consolation, I’m impressed by that last answer. Especially since it was based on a piece of 1960’s literature and not a popular 2000’s television series.
: It was one of the first books Rin ever read. Took it right from my collection.
: Didn’t take you as much of a reader.
: Used to be. Not so much anymore.
: Just fell out of love with it one day. But it’s not like I was ever reading any of that advanced stuff anyway. It was mainly just children’s books and stuff.
: Then where exactly does all of this trivia knowledge that I am definitely sure you possess come from?
: Hey, what’s with the sarcasm? I’ve got a 100%% correct answer rate so far. You have no reason to doubt me.

: Sure, apart from the sample size being two. It’s just a little weird that you know so much when you claimed yourself to not be very “book smart.” Yet here you are answering questions from two books.
: Game of Thrones was a book?
: Rika-
: I don’t have a fun or exciting answer for you, man. I’m just good at remembering useless information and I used to watch Jeopardy with Rie back in the day.
: Rie being...Rin’s other mom, I’m assuming?
: Yeah. Sorry. Wasn’t aware you didn’t know her name.
: We were always super competitive about it. But she was way smarter than I was, so she had an upper hand and-
: Actually, let’s talk about something else. I don’t want to waste this whole intermission thing reminiscing about stuff that is probably going to make me cry into my beer.
: I thought you were done with crying?
: Yeah, me too. Which is why I think we should stop and do something else.
: Like?
: How about you pick? I feel bad sucking you into this game thing when you probably just came here to drink and relax.
: I can pick?
: Sure. Yeah. Pick whatever you want and we can do that.
: I mean...
: You mean?
: There are two bathrooms here, you know.
: Do you have to go? I can wait.
: Not what I was saying.
: Then what-
: Oh.
: That’s what you meant.
: I was just-
: Do you think I’m a slut?
: I’m not trying to be confrontational and I won’t blame you if you do. I just want to know.
: I mean...you definitely have a lot of stories. And I have seen you make out with Imani on a dare.
: Yeah. That’s fair.
: I won’t pretend like my younger years weren’t a little...all over the place. I was far from innocent and...definitely...experimented a lot.
: But it’s not like that lifestyle followed me when I met Rie. That was me, like...genuinely settling down.
: And the Imani thing was a combination of break-up pain and not really thinking kissing is a big deal. But, then again, that’s probably just because I’ve...with a lot of...yeah...
: Besides, she’s the one you want anyway, right? And I’m just the spontaneous, easy backup plan.
: You think I want Imani?
: Yeah, I mean...even if you're not dating, aren't you guys kind of, like...together-ish?
: Like...there’s definitely some kind of “will they, won’t they” thing going on with you two and I just kind of figured there was some...tension.
: Didn’t you also think something similar about Wakana and me during our first meeting?
: Lowkey, I still kind of think that. But Wakana is a friend and I know she loves Osako.
: You and Imani, though...I’m surprised you’re, like...not together-ish if that’s what you’re trying to tell me right now.
: That is what I’m trying to tell you right now. Weirdly enough, absolutely nothing has happened between the two of us yet.
: Okay, but like...why?
: What do you mean why?
: I mean she obviously likes you. You know that, right?
: Whenever you’re not around, she’s always checking her phone and asking us if she should invite you or not. It’s super noticeable. And you’ve got crazy good chemistry when you are together.
: Like, frankly, it feels kind of weird hanging out with you when she’s not around because I keep thinking of how jealous she’d be and stuff.
: Does she really do all of that?
: Yeah. She’s down bad for you, dude. I don’t get why you don’t just go for it.
: Are you, like...with someone else already?
: If I was, would I have invited you to the bathroom a few minutes ago?
: You think that’s ever stopped anyone from inviting me into other bathrooms?
: Good point.
: You know, I probably shouldn’t be telling you this, but I am seeing someone else. Several people actually.
: Why shouldn’t you be telling me that? I’m not going to blurt it out to anyone.
: You mean like how you blurted out that thing about Rin taking too long in the shower because of teenage hormones?
: This is different. This is serious. Your secret’s safe with me, goober.
: Stop calling me that.
: No. It’s a term of endearment now. So tell me what’s up.
: If you’re seeing so many other people, what’s stopping you from getting with Imani when literally everyone ever knows she wants it?
: Come on. I know you know the answer.
: That’s...kind of the thing. I don’t.
: We joke about our relationship all the time. And I definitely want to have sex with her because she’s extremely attractive.
: But I also...
: Think I might...actually care about her?
: You say that like it’s a bad thing.
: It is, though. That sort of thing normally doesn’t happen until after I’ve already started “progressing” things with someone.
: But with Imani, everything feels a little too natural already. Like we’re already-
: Together-ish?
: Together-ish.
: I just like the way things are right now and don’t want to ruin what we have going.
: So you won’t hook up with her because you care about her.
: Right.
: But you’ll hook up with me because you don’t care.
: That’s not what I-
: I didn’t...mean it like that.
: You did.
: And it’s fine that you did. I get it.
: I’d probably have a hard time taking me seriously too.
: I’m sad. Alone. Open. Friendly. Gullible. Dumb. Old. Have a hard time saying no.
: All signs point to me being an easy target. I’m not gonna blame you for trying to take a shot.
: I just don’t want to be that kind of person anymore.
: Uhh...I’m gonna head home for the night. Sorry for flaking. It’s not your fault, it’s mine.
: You can’t leave yet. I need a partner for the rest of the game.
: Those two won’t be back for at least an hour. And I don’t want to wind up giving you even more reasons to not care about me, so...yeah.
: I’ll see you next time, though. And again, this is a me thing. Not a you thing. You didn’t do anything wrong and-
: Yeah. I just...fucked up the vibes. That’s my bad, man. See you next- yeah. Already said that.
: Later! Sorry!
The MC comes back into the bar a few minutes later and notices that everyone else has left.
I solemnly answer his trivia questions on my own.
And even though I win, it feels like I lose.
Rika’s affection has increased by 3!
You have unsuccessfully attempted to seduce a woman!
Maybe you should stick to children!
